visualCharacteristics: New: dynamic NSW DoE planning/reporting widget that fetches the school's published annual reports or school plan PDFs (by reporttype and schoolcode) and renders them as a bulleted list of PDF links. Built on the project widget loader (/widgets/planningreporting.html?reporttype=..&schoolcode=..).
contentPattern: Dynamic, data-driven component configured by key/value rows: cannot be typed as default content.

usage.description: Bulleted list of the school's published annual reports or school excellence plans (PDF links with year, name, type and size), loaded live from the NSW DoE school-plan-report API.

reuseGuidance: Use wherever the school's annual reports (reporttype report) or school plans (reporttype plan) must be listed; the list updates itself as new reports are published. Hidden when the API returns nothing.
tableStructure: Key/value rows: reporttype | report (annual reports) or plan (school excellence plans); schoolcode | 8504; optional recentreports | <number>
Alternative (widget convention): one cell with a link /widgets/planningreporting.html?reporttype=report&schoolcode=8504
